en: Primary volley gains +1 same-axis split shot (wider spread).
zh_TW: 主齊射額外 +1 發同軸分裂彈（較寬散射）。

en: On hit, split shots spawn from enemy position: 3->4->5->6 (max 6 = 360 deg). Split shots deal 50% damage and cannot chain.
zh_TW: 命中後從敵人位置生成分裂彈：3->4->5->6 發（6 發為 360 度）。分裂彈傷害為 50%，且不可連鎖分裂。

en: Primary damage bonus scales by stack: +50% -> +100% -> +150%.
Block one hit, then enter cooldown.
zh_TW: 抵擋一次傷害後進入冷卻。

en: On kill: 12% chance to heal 1 HP.
zh_TW: 擊殺時有 12% 機率回復 1 點生命。

en: Every 5s, one explosive charge is prepared and kept until fired. The next shot detonates on first hit or max distance, dealing AoE damage.
zh_TW: 每 5 秒準備 1 層引爆充能，未射擊時會保留。下一發子彈命中首個目標或達到最遠距離時引爆，造成範圍傷害。

en: Ranged shots become tracking rounds. After launch, they seek the nearest enemy ahead.
zh_TW: 遠程攻擊改為追蹤彈。發射後會尋找子彈前方最近的敵人。

en: Ranged attacks pierce enemies. Stack increases extra penetrations: 1 -> 2 -> 3.
zh_TW: 遠程攻擊可貫穿敵人。升級後額外貫穿次數為 1 -> 2 -> 3。

en: Ranged attacks bounce to another nearby enemy on hit. Stack increases bounce count up to 3.
zh_TW: 遠程攻擊命中後會彈跳至附近另一名敵人。升級可提高彈跳次數，最多 3 次。
